description.it: Giorni tra prestito e restituzione dei libri restituiti, per tipo di utente (esclusi gli smarriti).
description.en: Days between loan and return of the returned books, by patron type (lost books excluded).

sql: SELECT l.patron_type_snapshot AS patron_type, COUNT(*) AS loans, ROUND(AVG(julianday(l.returned_at) - julianday(l.issued_at)), 1) AS avg_days, MAX(CAST(julianday(l.returned_at) - julianday(l.issued_at) AS INTEGER)) AS max_days FROM loan l WHERE l.returned_at IS NOT NULL AND date(l.issued_at) BETWEEN :from AND :to AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan_event e WHERE e.loan_id = l.id AND e.type = 'lost') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
